name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Separately authored solid Heart pairs fuller, outward-bowed lower flanks with a softened tip. Mirrored convex Bezier curves replace the straight diagonal taper and preserve the same apparent-size relationship to Outline. Filled bounds x=2.4..21.6, y=3.25..20.75 remain centered. No interior counters or strokes. Not owner-approved.
